hotels.title: Mooloolaba Resort-Style Apartments Steps from the Esplanade with Complimentary Beach Cabana
hotels.description: Renowned as one of the best beaches in the South Pacific and a 30-minute drive from the world-famous Australia Zoo, Mooloolaba is a must-visit destination along the Sunshine Coast. These self-contained apartments meld home-away-from-home comforts with luxury living, featuring private balconies or courtyards, floor-to-ceiling windows and modern kitchens bathed in natural sunlight. Onsite, you can swim laps in the pool and stay fit in the fitness centre, all just moments from the main thoroughfare. Each evening, relax and take in sweeping views from your private balcony. Your spacious apartment puts you within steps of the patrolled main beach, where white-sandy shores open up to rolling sapphire waves, and delicious seaside fare lines the esplanade - perfect for dinner after a day spent in your included cabana. This sun-drenched destination offers access to some of Australia’s best experiences, including Sea Life Sunshine Coast.

hotels.title: Sunshine Coast Escape Moments from Mooloolaba Beach with Two Pools & Rooftop Barbecue Area
hotels.description: Experience the best of the Sunshine Coast with a stay along the beautiful Mooloolaba Beach. Perfectly positioned on the Esplanade, this beachfront retreat is a stone's throw from the vibrant Mooloolaba dining and shopping precinct and less than a 30-minute drive from Australia Zoo. With an outdoor pool, indoor heated pool, and a fabulous rooftop barbecue area, this escape offers a perfect blend of relaxation and activity.

hotels.title: Sleek Sunshine Coast Beachfront Apartments on Mooloolaba Esplanade with Infinity Pool & BBQ Facilities
hotels.description: Make waves and embrace the laidback coastal lifestyle of the Sunshine Coast's Mooloolaba with a centrally located apartment stay. From the heated outdoor infinity pool facing the aquamarine waves of Mooloolaba Beach to the BBQ facilities, this collection of self-contained apartments is the perfect base for sun-kissed adventures or exploring the Glasshouse Mountains further afield. Located on the Mooloolaba Esplanade, you’re never far from the action - with trendy beachfront eateries, delicious cafes and the sparkling wharf sitting on the picturesque stretch. With popular attractions like Sea Life Sunshine Coast Aquarium, Australia Zoo or the Eumundi Markets a short drive away, this stay is the ideal choice for a family escape.

hotels.title: Serene Sunshine Coast Beachside Two- & Three-Bedroom Apartment Escape Overlooking Mooloolaba Bay
hotels.description: Whisk off to the Sunshine Coast and bask in the coastal allure with a tranquil apartment stay, alongside the stunning Mooloolaba Bay. Conveniently located on the Esplanade, be in the heart of action with trendy sidewalk cafes, restaurants and boutiques, just a short stroll away. Relax and unwind in the well-appointed, spacious apartments with modern amenities, all while enjoying panoramic ocean views. Choose to go for a swim either in the property's seasonally heated pool or indulge in some beach fun with surf-friendly waves and a plethora of water sports adventures to experience. Or, head out and visit the nearby Australia Zoo and Sea Life Sunshine Coast Aquarium.

hotels.title: Five-Star Sunshine Coast Self-Contained Family Beachfront Escape
hotels.description: Experience the ultimate laidback escape at this five-star beachfront haven, ideally located on the sun-kissed shores of Mooloolaba Beach in Queensland's Sunshine Coast. This incredible high-rise retreat places the Mooloolaba Esplanade and its iconic beach at your fingertips with a list of facilities to keep you entertained, including an outdoor pool and spa, gym, steam room and a movie theatrette. Plunge into this postcard-perfect location from your luxurious apartment and you'll never want to leave.
